original_query: select   i_item_id  ,i_item_desc  ,s_store_id  ,s_store_name  ,stddev_samp(ss_net_profit) as store_sales_profit  ,stddev_samp(sr_net_loss) as store_returns_loss  ,stddev_samp(cs_net_profit) as catalog_sales_profit  from  store_sales  ,store_returns  ,catalog_sales  ,date_dim d1  ,date_dim d2  ,date_dim d3  ,store  ,item  where  d1.d_moy = 4  and d1.d_year = 2001  and d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk  and i_item_sk = ss_item_sk  and s_store_sk = ss_store_sk  and ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk  and ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk  and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number  and sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk  and d2.d_moy               between 4 and  4 + 2  and d2.d_year              = 2001  and sr_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk  and sr_item_sk = cs_item_sk  and cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk  and d3.d_moy               between 4 and  4 + 2  and d3.d_year              = 2001  group by  i_item_id  ,i_item_desc  ,s_store_id  ,s_store_name  order by  i_item_id  ,i_item_desc  ,s_store_id  ,s_store_name  limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH apr_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4
      AND d_year = 2001
),
apr_jun_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 6
      AND d_year = 2001
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    stddev_samp(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    stddev_samp(sr.sr_net_loss)   AS store_returns_loss,
    stddev_samp(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN apr_dates d1
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk   = sr.sr_customer_sk
   AND ss.ss_item_sk       = sr.sr_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
JOIN apr_jun_dates d2
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
   AND sr.sr_item_sk     = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN apr_jun_dates d3
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
JOIN store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name
ORDER BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Constant folding: `d_moy between 4 and 4 + 2` rewritten as `d_moy between 4 and 6`.

date_dim d2 and d3 use identical predicates (Apr–Jun 2001). Consolidated into a single reusable CTE `apr_jun_dates`, avoiding a redundant scan/filter of date_dim (73,049 rows; filtered set is only ~92 rows). date_dim d1's predicate placed into its own small CTE `apr_dates` for early filtering.
Converted implicit comma-style joins into explicit ANSI JOINs with pre-filtered date CTEs joined early, improving readability and letting the planner treat the tiny date-sk sets as driving relations.
